```{r, message = FALSE}
library('dplyr')
data <- read.table("BirthWeights.txt", sep = " ", header = TRUE, as.is = FALSE)
```

# 1. 

```{r}
# Design matrix
X <- model.matrix(~ Mage + Gage + Race + Gen, data = data)
y <- matrix(data[, 1], ncol = 1)

# beta = (X'X)^(-1)*X'y
beta <- solve(t(X) %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% y

# S2
n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)
resids <- y - (X %*% beta)
S2 <- sum(resids^2) / (n-p)

lm <- lm(BirthWeight ~ ., data = data)

beta
lm$coefficients

S2
summary(lm)$sigma^2
```

# 2. 

```{r}
# Manual vs. LM
table(round(X %*% beta, 3) == round(lm$fitted.values, 3))
```

# 3. 

```{r}
# Manual vs. LM
table(round(y - X%*%beta, 3) == round(lm$residuals, 3))
```
